explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Crest must precede Acorn." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Acorn → Estuary → Dune → Beacon → Crest
- Dune → Acorn → Estuary → Beacon → Crest
- Dune → Beacon → Acorn → Estuary → Crest
